details.summary: This is an outstanding recipe that perfectly meets the book's culinary and dietary criteria. It brilliantly leverages everyday convenience items (frozen vegetables, grain pouches) to deliver a sophisticated, flavorful, and compliant Spanish-inspired stew in under 20 minutes.

dimensions.feedback: The flavor profile is excellent and highly coherent. The smoky paprika and garlic provide the warm base, while the sherry vinegar offers a necessary acidic lift to brighten the earthy grains and rich tomatoes.
All ingredients listed are used in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients appear in the steps.

Instructions are thorough. Excellent use of time ranges, check times (e.g., '3 to 4 minutes, checking at 3 minutes'), and visual doneness cues ('softened', 'highly fragrant', 'hot and opaque'). Pulling the pot from the heat immediately to avoid rubbery shrimp is a great culinary touch.
Perfectly aligns with a Spanish-inspired Mediterranean style. The use of sherry vinegar, smoked paprika, tomatoes, and olive oil is classic and authentic to the region.
Stovetop simmering is the right method for a quick stew. Using pre-cooked shrimp and adding them at the very end to gently warm through prevents them from overcooking and becoming tough.
The computed nutrition is highly plausible. The macro profile perfectly reflects a heavy vegetable base, lean shrimp protein, and a moderate portion of whole grains.

The title is descriptive and accurate. The intro is culinary, engaging, and devoid of banned health claims, 'detox' language, or scare tactics. It expertly focuses on the flavor swap (sherry vinegar/paprika for chorizo).
Highly appealing. It's a fast, comforting, and flavorful one-pot meal that looks great in a bowl and offers sophisticated flavors with minimal effort.
Perfectly executes the dual mandate. It uses lean protein (shrimp), a quality complex carbohydrate (brown rice and quinoa), and plenty of vegetables, anchored by heart-healthy olive oil.

Zero added sugar, as required. The carbohydrate component (42.5 g) lands perfectly in the upper end of the 25-45 g window, supplied by high-quality whole grains and vegetables rather than refined sources.
Hits the 'light_main' tier perfectly. At 36.5 g protein, 8.1 g fiber, and 244 mg sodium, it firmly meets the chapter targets for a substantial soup that serves as an actual meal.

Easily achieved in under 30 minutes from a cold start. The use of a frozen pepper/onion blend and a ready-to-eat grain pouch are excellent, first-class shortcuts that fit the book's everyday ingredient ethos. Thawing pre-cooked shrimp under cold water takes about 5 minutes, keeping the total time well within bounds.
